Name: ... contains keyword(s)
Notes: This operator tests whether some text contains certain words. It takes the argument supplied, breaks it up into component words, removes any 'stop' words (short, common words like 'the' or 'a'), and looks for the resulting word(s). For example, searching for ‘cat hat’, ‘cat in hat’, ‘cat in the hat’, ‘the hat cat’, or ‘hat cat’ would return ‘the cat in the hat’. This does not respect partial words that are not of the same stem, so 'pepp' would not return 'peppers'.
